meta.title: ARTLY — art that fits your interior
meta.description: Snap a photo of your wall and tell us what you like — we’ll show you works by independent artists matched to your space, style and budget. See them on your wall before you buy.

langbar.available: This page is also available in English.

hero.title: Art that truly fits your interior.
hero.lead: Snap a photo of your wall and tell us what you like — we’ll show you works by independent artists matched to your space, style and budget. Then see them on your own wall before you buy.

items.title: You start with your space
items.text: Your room, your style and your needs come first — the catalogue comes second. We match works to your wall colour, light and proportions.

items.title: See the result before you buy
items.text: The artwork appears on a photo of your wall at true scale. Change the size and frame, and compare “before” and “after”.

items.title: Support independent creators
items.text: Buy originals directly from artists in your country, get to know their stories and commission a piece made to measure.

steps.title: Four steps to a piece of your own
steps.label: Steps

items.title: Show your space
items.text: Snap a photo of a wall in your living room, bedroom or office.

items.title: Set your taste

items.title: See the result

items.title: Buy or commission
items.text: Buy a finished work or commission one from the artist.

nearby.title: Artists near you
nearby.text: We mainly show creators from the country you live in. That means faster delivery, simpler purchases and sometimes even pickup straight from the studio. If you like, you can open ARTLY up to all of Europe.

language.title: In your language
language.text: The app speaks your phone’s language. We translate artwork descriptions — with the artist’s original always just a tap away.

artists.title: Your art will find its place.
artists.text: We show your work to people whose spaces it truly suits. You create — we make the rest easier.

items.q: Do I have to take a photo of my room?
items.a: No. You can start browsing artworks right away. A photo of your wall, though, makes the recommendations more accurate and lets the preview show the piece at true scale.

items.q: How does a made-to-measure commission work?
items.a: You send the artist a description, size, budget and deadline. The artist replies with a quote and a sketch — you only pay once you approve them.

items.q: Where do the artworks come from?
items.a: From independent artists who add their own work to ARTLY. By default, we show creators from your country.

items.q: How do I become an artist on ARTLY?
items.a: Download the app and choose “Join Artly”. Create an account, tell your story and add photos of your work — once your profile is approved, buyers will see your pieces.

cta.title: Art finds its place.
cta.text: Artists find their audience. Download the app and see what will hang on your wall.
